players.product: photonic fault-tolerant quantum computers; Inception photonic chip manufacturing facility (Toronto, 158,000 sq ft)

quarterly_data.signal: Xanadu (6-K): will establish 'Inception', an advanced photonics research, development and manufacturing facility in Toronto under Project OPTIMISM - a 158,000-square-foot site for the manufacturing, packaging and assembly of quantum computing components, with cleanrooms, round-the-clock test and measurement and heterogeneous integration, housing its Systems Integration and Operation Centre where quantum modules are assembled, tested and verified before installation in server racks.
Xanadu (6-K): the planned Inception facility is to integrate specialized tooling from ASMPT, Bluefors, DISCO, EVG, FiconTEC and MPI (a stated plan; no order disclosed).
